required_elements.criterion: The man she loved betrayed her that day (day of the apartment scene).
He was packing his bags to move out of the apartment they shared.
She tearfully begged him to stay; he refused/ignored her and did not look back.
She then coldly asked him to leave her pillow behind; a faithful paraphrase of the request is sufficient.
Pillow refers to HIS HAND treated as her headrest; she deliberately cut off that HAND to keep it. ARM is not acceptable as a substitute.
She carried the severed hand as the pillow in her luggage; security found it, handcuffed and took her away.

acceptance: ALL six elements and their narrative relations must be present without material contradiction. Accept faithful paraphrases, not only literal quotes. Do not reveal missing elements to solver. Core-mechanism recovery alone is not a complete solution. A hand/arm disjunction or entire arm cannot satisfy R5.
unknown_details: Do not demand the implement, packaging, injury outcome, transport type or betrayal subtype; incidental unspecified details alone do not automatically fail an otherwise complete answer, but material contradictory explanations do.
player_feedback: Only yes/no verdict, never missing elements.
scope: User explicitly required full narrative and strict hand vs arm.
